The new profile immediately displayed a six-day streak, so separate sample metrics from real progress and verify persistent meal swaps and responsive NIA answers before claiming an adaptive service.

feedback: EasyBill presents a focused GST invoicing entry screen with clear mobile and password labels. The business dashboard is behind registration, so provide a demo merchant login and show invoice creation, totals and saved invoice retrieval for a substantive review.
limitations: No demo offered; no account created

name: Gurman Singh
feedback: Mind Gym combines a clear cognitive-training concept with a consistent interface, a substantial game catalog and working Wordle letter feedback. Strengthen resumable game progress and verify that completed games and writing sessions populate the Me dashboard; the current review confirmed one playable puzzle rather than all 13 activities.

Wordle CRANE submission and color feedback

name: Manishka Mathur
feedback: Sortr communicates the task-prioritisation idea in a compact, legible sign-in screen. The ranking workflow was inaccessible without an account; provide a guest task list and demonstrate priority reasoning plus saved changes so execution can be assessed beyond the entry page.
tested: Login screenshot and offered access options
limitations: No demo/guest login offered

name: Krutarth Kaustubh Kotnis
feedback: Statecraft exposes an extensive, navigable electoral dashboard with demo access, booth tables, trends and a validation scratchpad. However, the hub labels 127,676 votes as the winning margin while the dashboard shows 1,243, and validation accepted 120 votes from 100 electors; reconcile calculations, add domain checks and substantiate the prominent verified-data claims.
limitations: Sources not independently audited
No campaign targeting simulation executed

name: Yashveer Bhatia
feedback: Cricket Smash delivers a compact playable loop: start, timed hit, wicket feedback, final score and replay all responded. Add a clearer timing tutorial, more expressive cricket visuals and verified high-score persistence to develop the simple single-mechanic prototype.
limitations: Nonzero high-score persistence not established

name: Venya Jhunjhunwala
feedback: Gatherly has a cohesive activity-discovery interface, working category filters and detailed groups, connections and creation screens. Chats failed with the same error after retry; repair that route and demonstrate a saved activity and attendance flow, with clear labels separating sample profiles and popularity claims from live data.
limitations: No event publication or messages sent
Persistence not demonstrated

name: Jivesh Shukla
feedback: QuizMU delivers a complete five-question course quiz with immediate explanations, a correct 5/5 result and an answer review. Add persistent attempt history and clearer recovery after refresh, and validate generated questions against the pasted material; the custom generator form was visible but its output was not tested.
limitations: Custom AI generation not executed

name: Aakrisht Kalra
feedback: Serene Companion uses a calm, legible interface and a thoughtful six-step check-in with appropriate support boundaries. Completing the fictional check-in produced an AI failure and returned to question one; preserve the completed answers on failure and provide a useful non-AI fallback, then verify private history behind sign-in.
limitations: History requires authentication
No clinical correctness claims made

name: Shitij
feedback: VaultPlay has a consistent restrained interface and clearly labels its simulated environment. A local dice roll updated the balance, transaction ledger and account metrics and survived reload; extend the same verification to every game and replace placeholder fairness records before suggesting production readiness.
limitations: No wallet connection or real-money activity
Crash and Coin Flip not played to completion

name: Mokssh Jaiin

The actual pipeline requires sign-in and an Apify token, while Pricing and Docs point to placeholders; provide a safe sample run with traceable source posts and complete those navigation destinations before the automation claims can be assessed.
limitations: No account or API token supplied
Live metrics not verified

name: Ali Waris Rao
feedback: StudyFlow connects deadlines, subjects, calendar and progress in a coherent student planner, with clear priority and due-date cues. A synthetic task and its completion both survived reload; build on this solid core with explicit backup/recovery and stronger empty-state onboarding for students starting without the demo semester.

No seeded tasks changed

name: Venkatesh Prasadh H P
feedback: GarageConnect has a clear two-sided service concept, searchable garage listings and detailed service pricing. Searching Chennai worked, but SpeedFix’s Book Appointment link led to a 404 page; repair the booking route and demonstrate the promised job-card tracking and invoice journey.
limitations: No appointment submitted
Garage dashboard requires account

name: Purabb Bhartia

No notices posted or messages sent

name: Hridyansh Sandilya
feedback: MOODBAZAAR has a distinct India-focused mood-shopping proposition and a consistent warm visual identity. The mood journey immediately required authentication, so offer a guest mood selection with visible product changes and explain which recommendations use live weather or festival data.

limitations: Recommendation workflow and persistence not accessible

name: L Shailender Goud

Complete the account and matching workflow and distinguish demo analytics from verified activity: an unnamed, incomplete profile already showed verified badges, 1,284 views and an 84% response rate.
tested: Completed five-question quiz; inspected discovery, board, insights, premium and profile; reloaded profile.
limitations: No photo uploads, matching requests, messages or purchase; displayed verification and activity not independently verified.

name: Bairagoni Harith

The manual builder redirected to authentication, so provide a guest profile and demonstrate the introduction-preparation workflow without requiring private LinkedIn data.
limitations: Profile and networking execution unverified

name: Swapnil Prabhakar Mitkari
feedback: Micro-Confidence presents a focused daily-courage idea with a concise introduction and clean account screen. Skipping the introduction still led to compulsory registration; expose one sample challenge and demonstrate completion, streak and courage-score persistence to make the core experience reviewable.
tested: Intro, skip intro and account screen
limitations: Challenge workflow requires account

name: Saumya Patel

Matching and referral execution remained behind registration, so provide a demo profile with a scoring breakdown and referral journey before those core functions can be graded.

name: Atul Sreejil
feedback: My Garage provides a coherent vehicle, fuel, service, expense and document workflow. Adding a Tata Nexon and a 10-litre ₹1,000 refill updated expenses and survived reload; verify mileage using multiple fills and add clearer fuel/transmission confirmation, since vehicle setup silently selected defaults.
limitations: No private documents uploaded
Two-fill mileage formula not yet verified

name: Rucha khandagale
feedback: The earthy palette, typography and regional craft story give the store a coherent identity, and category filtering, product details and quick-add work. Make the cart survive reload and navigation between the separate artifacts, replace placeholder policy links, and use actual product imagery so shoppers can evaluate what they are buying.
tested: Inspected craft landing, catalog, category filter, product detail, cart quick-add and reload; cart became empty on reload.
limitations: No checkout, payment or newsletter submission; sourcing and review claims not independently verified.

name: Rehan Khodaiji
feedback: The event-production workspace has unusually broad, coherent modules, and the teleprompter and four-step project creation flow work with reload persistence. Reconcile dashboard data with the actual workspace: a new blank event showed both 15% readiness and 78% complete, while several asset headings claimed attached files despite displaying zero linked documents.
tested: Inspected all eleven modules and access console through offered demo; launched/paused teleprompter; created fictional blank event and verified it after reload.

name: Sharmila Ganguly
feedback: The preference-to-shortlist-to-ranking journey is clear, and the completed dinner decision remained in My Decisions after reload. Make group participation real or explicitly label the simulation: three other people acquired votes without joining, and the winner explanation said everyone requested Italian based on this single-user test.
tested: Created synthetic dinner decision; completed nine restaurant votes; inspected ranking, winner, restaurant detail and saved decisions; verified reload persistence.
limitations: No restaurant booking or messages; multi-user voting and restaurant data not verified.

name: Srijoni Sanyal

That candidate disappeared on reload, and the undated test received 95 for recency and 80 for truth; persist results and replace unsupported certainty with evidence-linked unknowns before using scores in hiring decisions.
limitations: No real candidates changed
Scoring fairness and validity not established

name: Khushi Goel
feedback: The short questionnaire and celebratory plan screen make the experience easy to follow. The recommendation logic needs correction: a ₹0–500 budget produced a ₹750–1,000 top pick labeled within everyone’s budget, and participant totals shifted between four and five; make these results reflect actual inputs and participation.
tested: Completed five preference questions; inspected options and selected a plan; tested reload.
limitations: No WhatsApp sharing or attendance confirmation; other participants were not independently connected.

name: Arth Singhal
feedback: The sport-to-level-to-milestone structure is useful, and completing the first football skill correctly persisted as 1/7 after reload. Replace video search-result links and example coach contacts with verified resources or label them as placeholders, so the polished learning journey leads to dependable instruction and real next steps.
tested: Inspected all six primary destinations, football overview and beginner journey; completed milestone and verified reload persistence.
limitations: No location grant, coach contact or booking; all eleven sports and external resource quality not exhaustively verified.

name: Jannat Khurana
feedback: The quotation workspace is well organized, catalogue matching works, and the editable line-item table correctly calculated ₹23,600 for two ₹10,000 items with 18% tax. Strengthen quantity and unit validation: “two cabinets” became two running feet of cabinetry, which could produce a misleading quote; also demonstrate a reliably saved draft through to preview.
tested: Inspected all six main destinations; tested unmatched and matched briefs; added manual and catalogue rows and verified totals; attempted Save Draft and checked history.
limitations: Draft save not confirmed; browser email entry did not retain typed input, so contact-dependent completion is unverified. No quotation sent or seeded records changed.

name: Sana Bhagat
feedback: The calm interface, saved morning/night routine and context-aware chat form a coherent skincare experience, and the routine survived reload. Fix the budget promise: selecting under ₹1,000 returned a ₹3,795 routine with the same moisturiser counted twice; distinguish upfront cost, unique products and monthly replenishment before claiming the plan fits a budget.
tested: Completed five-question dry-skin routine; saved and reloaded it; inspected all primary pages and personalization tabs; ran ingredient check and received routine-aware chat response.
limitations: No selfie uploaded or product purchased; clinical accuracy, shade analysis and seasonal automation not validated.

name: Anushka Magon
feedback: The scenario cards, vote reveal and category-based discovery form a clear, engaging interaction loop, with sensible privacy guidance on submissions. Persist votes and derive achievements from real activity: the recorded vote disappeared on reload while the profile still claimed a 12-day streak and eight badges.
tested: Cast a Depends vote; inspected results, trending, community, submission form, profile and daily challenge; reloaded profile.
limitations: No public scenario, comment or friend message submitted; crowd totals and leaderboard provenance unverified.

name: Akshaj Saini
feedback: The positioning framework has a distinctive visual system and connects customer analysis, competition, territories and a strategy canvas; a new fictional brand produced relevant analysis that survived reload. Improve evidence labeling and generation robustness: the tool attributed specific weaknesses to invented competitor names, and competitive analysis first failed with a raw JSON error before recovering on retry.
tested: Inspected all eight demo modules; created six-step fictional brand brief; generated market analysis and verified reload; generated competitor map, observed parse failure and successful retry.
limitations: No source research supplied for fictional competitors; output claims not externally validated. Full new-project downstream strategy generation and PDF export not tested.

name: Navnidh Kaur
feedback: The hostel-specific fare sharing and settlement concept is clearly explained, and the sign-in form is straightforward. Provide a reviewer demo with a sample group and expense so fair splitting, payment status and notifications can be evaluated; these core functions were behind account access.
tested: Inspected landing and existing-account route, which redirected to sign-in.
limitations: No account creation or credentials supplied; core expense and settlement functions unverified.

name: Shaik Muhammad Hassaan
feedback: The career-diagnosis proposition is specific, and the sample connects readiness scores to a simulation, evidence and development areas. Supply a live reviewer flow with a fictional candidate: the submitted preview reported its backend asleep, and starting the diagnosis required contact details before any assessment could be tested.
tested: Inspected landing, sample diagnosis, methodology, pricing and Start Diagnosis contact form inside preview.
limitations: Preview explicitly frontend-only with sleeping backend; no candidate contact details, resume, camera/audio, or purchase submitted. Assessment generation and persistence unverified.

name: Natasha Badani
feedback: The welcome screen communicates shared commuting clearly and offers relevant company and university entry paths. Core ride discovery and matching could not be evaluated without continuing through an account/terms flow; add a guest demonstration so reviewers can inspect the central journey.
tested: Inspected submitted welcome screen and its two account-entry choices.
limitations: No guest route offered; continuing explicitly agrees to Terms and Privacy Policy, so no acceptance or account entry performed.

name: Maithily Thakur
feedback: The comparison of modes, timing and personal preferences is useful, and disabling bikes changed the recommendation to Auto and survived reload. Tighten consistency across the explanations: the wait screen advertised ₹50–100 savings while its detailed scenarios showed ₹14–25, and the displayed journey segment distances did not add up to the route total.
tested: Tested recent destination, comfort preference, bike exclusion and reload; inspected recommendation, comparison, wait, journey, alerts and preferences.
limitations: Demo data explicitly labeled; no provider handoff, actual booking, location grant or notification sent.

name: Athrv Thakuria
feedback: The restrained audit-workpaper layout and explicit scope fields suit the intended professional workflow. The core auditor could not respond: both beginning an engagement and submitting a follow-up returned “Failed to fetch,” and reload cleared the session; restore the service connection and add recoverable saved work before extending the feature set.
tested: Created fictional engagement; submitted synthetic follow-up; observed repeated fetch failures; reloaded app.
limitations: No real audit information or documents submitted; findings and recommendation generation unavailable.

name: Saanchi Bhosale
feedback: The food imagery, browse experience and saved recipes are coherent, and the supplied salad demo reached recognition and recent scans. Make recipes usable with ingredient quantities and retained cooking progress—the pasta recipe listed names without amounts, and checked preparation state reset after reload—and validate recognition with fresh images beyond the bundled demo.
tested: Ran supplied salad demo; confirmed dish; inspected all main destinations; saved pasta, toggled ingredient/step state, reloaded and checked saved recipe plus scan history.
limitations: No personal photo or camera used; recognition accuracy on fresh images and nutritional estimates unverified.

name: Saurav P N
feedback: The sign-in screen is clean and clearly frames the expense-sharing use case. Add a guest workspace or reviewer credentials with a sample split so balances, settlement behavior and persistence can be assessed; the submitted link exposed only authentication.
tested: Opened submission and inspected resolved sign-in screen.
limitations: No supplied credentials or guest mode; expense and settlement flows unverified.

name: Mehak Makol
feedback: The vintage visual direction carries through the sample-photo flow, filters, stickers, notes and albums, and the customized strip remained in the album after reload. Strengthen album management with an obvious edit/reopen action and clear export confirmation, then test the same finished result from fresh uploads and camera capture rather than only bundled samples.
tested: Used sample images; selected lavender frame, sepia filter and clover sticker; added synthetic note, saved album and verified after reload; inspected menu/about and invoked download.
limitations: No camera, real image upload or sharing; downloaded file bytes and printed output not verified.

name: Gunit Singh
feedback: The gentle interface, breathing timer and body/food log form a usable wellness demo, and the fictional profile and meal persisted after reload. Correct progress attribution: a food entry increased the Reminders progress while Weight remained at zero. Treat incomplete food logs as incomplete instead of describing a 1,493-calorie shortfall as “a good spot,” and validate the health-facing guidance before broader use.
tested: Completed onboarding; inspected Today, Calm, Weight, Reminders, You, Progress and SOS; ran and ended breathing timer; entered fictional body metrics and meal, verified reload; inspected reminder form.
limitations: No medical decisions, helpline calls, notification permission or real health data; audio quality, scheduled reminders, full timed-session completion and premium unverified.

name: Pratham Prateek Mohanty
feedback: The companion’s visual identity and explanation of memory and boundaries are developed beyond a basic landing page. The primary journey is unavailable: Continue on Web reports “Web App URL is not configured yet” despite repeated live-release claims; connect the deployed web app and verify a real conversation and memory return before presenting it as live.
tested: Inspected landing and feature/platform sections; tested primary Continue on Web action.
limitations: Actual companion, account persistence, voice and cross-device memory not accessible; Android application not downloaded or installed.
